inj.note: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn confirmed that Payne will be out long-term with a foot injury suffered in practice. With both Javon Kinlaw (knee) and Payne out, Tim Settle will have a larger role at nose tackle going forward.
inj.label: Out for season

news.h: Source: Commanders DT Daron Payne suffered season-ending foot injury
news.d: Commanders defensive tackle Daron Payne suffered a season-ending Jones fracture in practice Friday.

news.h: Sources: Commanders' Daron Payne likely IR-bound after practice injury
news.d: Commanders DT Daron Payne suffered a significant foot injury in practice Friday that likely will land him on injured reserve.
